title: UNM football selected 11th, two Lobos named preseason All-MW - NewsBreak
text: LAS VEGAS, N.V. (KRQE) – The 2025 Mountain West conference football media days kicked off on Wednesday from Las Vegas Nevada. League commissioner Gloria Nevarez gave a state of the conference address and player representatives from the 12 member schools spoke. UNM was selected in the preseason poll to finish in 11th. Two Lobos, running back Scottre Humphry and kick returner Abraham Williams were selected to the preseason All-Mountain West team. 2025 Mountain West Predicted Order of Finish Rank Team (first-place votes) Points 1. Boise State (35) 464 2. UNLV (4) 415 3. San José State 359 4. Colorado State 326 5. Fresno State 301 6. Air Force 280 7. Hawai’i 213 8. San Diego State 202 9. Utah State 165 10. Wyoming 150 11. New Mexico 84 12. Nevada 83 This season will be the last for the MW with the current 12 teams. Five teams (Boise State, Fresno State, Colorado State and San Diego State) are departing to join the PAC 12 in 2026. Commissioner Nevarez said that the league does not plan on adding another member in the immediate future. UTEP and Northern Illinois will join the Mountain West in 2026. Nevarez would not comment on anything regarding the settlement between the PAC-12. She also did not reveal anything on the new media rights deal. “We are committed to staying in the moment,” said Nevarez. “As change continues to impact our industry, we stand ready to meat those opportunities in alignment with our mission an values.” Coaches from all 12 schools will speak to the media on Thursday For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to KRQE NEWS 13 - Breaking News, Albuquerque News, New Mexico News, Weather, and Videos.
